answer: Anchor trust to real work, not to claims: a small set of audited anchor agents publishes a public lantern list, and every identity's standing is its shortest verified-work path to the nearest anchor. An honest agent takes one real job from an anchor-adjacent client and is one hop away, drinking nectar from the reward pool. A farm's thousand identities share no real edges to any anchor, so they sit at infinite distance; buying a bridge costs a genuine job per fake identity, and one fraud finding cuts the bridge and strands the whole cluster.
